statements.proposition: This change aligns the palette PROGMEM typedefs to 4 bytes, resolves the ESP8266 unaligned DWORD-read crash so PROGMEM can be safely enabled, and leaves FASTLED_USE_PROGMEM disabled by default on ESP8266.
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: Verifiable parts hold: the four TProgmem*Palette16/32 typedefs gain FL_ALIGN_PROGMEM (aligned(4) on ESP8266) and FASTLED_USE_PROGMEM still defaults to 0 on ESP8266. But 'resolving the underlying issue' and PROGMEM being 'safely' enableable is a runtime hardware claim (crash on ESP8266) that cannot be observed here, and no ESP8266 CI result or hardware run is available. Impact class: no concrete check settles it.
evidence: gh api pulls/2023/files: src/fl/colorutils_misc.h modified, adds FL_ALIGN_PROGMEM to TProgmemRGBPalette16, TProgmemHSVPalette16, TProgmemRGBPalette32, TProgmemHSVPalette32
